description: This multi-level pie chart represents a hierarchical categorization of tasks or capabilities, consisting of an inner ring with three primary categories and an outer ring with nine specific sub-categories. The inner ring includes the categories "Contradiction Resolution" colored brown, "Context Tracking" colored dark blue, and "Context Retrieving" colored dark green, with these labels written directly inside the slices in white text. The outer ring is divided into nine slices, each corresponding to an adjacent inner category. Grouped with "Contradiction Resolution" are "Prioritization" (light red, value 100), "Personalization" (orange-red, value 100), and "Privacy Protection" (bright red, value 111). Grouped with "Context Tracking" are "Triggering" (light blue, value 100), "Recursive Reasoning" (medium blue, value 110), and "Dynamic Environment" (dark blue, value 100). Grouped with "Context Retrieving" are "Memorization" (light cyan, value 100), "Dynamic Instruction" (turquoise, value 100), and "Multitasking" (green, value 160). The labels and numerical values for the outer ring are positioned outside the chart and connected to their respective slices by thin blue leader lines. The chart does not include a separate legend, nor are any slices visually emphasized by being exploded or offset. The segments are separated by white borders around a hollow center, and the outer slices are not ordered by descending size, though their visual areas appear roughly proportional to their assigned numerical values.
